segments.t: At the bar, Max coachingly whispers to Nastya to ask the masseur on the phone whether he offers anything intimate besides massage. When the masseur replies that they can arrange anything if she is pretty, Max grabs a bottle of wine and tricks reception into giving him Vika's room key.
Девушка, ну если вы симпатичная, то мы с вами обо всём договоримся.
Виктория Сергеевна попросила отнести это вино в номер, который она сняла.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Hello. Yes, all kinds of massage.' With the phone and test in play, Kostya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'Ask about intimacy!' Here telling Kostya to ask about intimacy lets Max's real feelings break through. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'And besides massage, anything intimate?' Over the wine and the room, Nastya presses Kostya for a straight answer.
Девушка, ну если вы симпатичная, то мы с вами обо всём договоримся.

'Miss, well if you are pretty, then you and I will agree on everything.' Noting that Max should miss well if Max is pretty then Max and he will agree on everything keeps Kostya's side of the story simple and clear. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
'Hang up the phone!' Saying that Kostya should hang up the phone is how Max takes charge of the moment. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'Thank you very much, I will call you back.' Mentioning that very much she will call Kostya back moves the talk in a new direction.

'I did not get that, what do you mean 'I will call you back'?' Questioning whether he did not get that what do Max means will call Max back is how Kostya tests Max's story. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.

'Well it was just a figure of speech!' Saying that it was just a figure of speech is how Nastya takes charge of the moment. Russian puts the key word right up front so her emotion lands on the first beat.
'Where are they heading, huh?' By asking where they heading huh are, Max presses Kostya for a straight answer.
'Vika said that she would book a room.' Nastya mentions that Vika said that she would book a room so Kostya sees what is at stake.
Виктория Сергеевна попросила отнести это вино в номер, который она сняла.

'Viktoriya Sergeyevna asked me to take this wine to the room she booked.' Claiming that Viktoriya Sergeyevna asked him to take this wine to the room she booked sounds confident, even if Kostya has doubts. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
'Give me the key, please!' Once Kostya should give him the key please, Max makes sure Kostya hears every word. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Девушка, ну если вы симпатичная, то мы с вами обо всём договоримся.
Виктория Сергеевна попросила отнести это вино в номер, который она сняла.
That brings the phone-test scene to a close. Notice Kostya's jealous reaction when Nastya tells the masseur she will call him back, and Max's trick to get the room key. See you next time!
